original_goal:
[Module: Logout | TC-001 | Type: Positive | Priority: High]
Title: Click Logout redirects user to Login page

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html
▶ Requires Auth: No
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": "standard_user",
  "password": "secret_sauce",
  "inventory_url": "https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html"
}

Preconditions:
  Test will authenticate using standard_user to reach a page with a visible Logout option.

Steps to Execute:
  1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com/ (Login page).
  2. Enter 'standard_user' in Username field
  3. Enter 'secret_sauce' in Password field
  4. Click the Login button
  5. On the Inventory page, click the Menu (burger) button
  6. Click the 'Logout' link in the side menu

Expected Result:
  The application redirects to the Login page; the Login page is displayed

Notes from prior verification:
  Rewrote the initial steps to perform an explicit login because the verification DOM snapshot was the Login page and did not contain a Logout control. Added steps to open the login page, sign in as standard_user, open the menu, and then click Logout so the test can proceed to validate redirection to Login.
expected_outcome: The application redirects to the Login page; the Login page is displayed
